woods.definition: Form of wood (plural): The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

wool.definition: The hair of the sheep, llama and some other ruminants.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

worded.definition: Form of word (participle past): To say or write (something) using particular words; to phrase (something).

words.definition: Form of word (plural): The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

wordy.definition: Using an excessive number of words.

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workbench.definition: A sturdy bench or table at which manual work is done by a carpenter, machinist, etc.

workday.definition: Any of the days of a week on which work is done; any day in a workweek.

workdays.definition: Form of workday (plural): Any of the days of a week on which work is done; any day in a workweek.

worked.definition: Form of work (participle past): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

worker.definition: One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

workers.definition: Form of worker (plural): One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

worker’s.definition: One who works: a person who performs labor for a living; traditionally, especially, manual labor.

workgirls.definition: Form of workgirl (plural): A young female laborer.

workhouse.definition: An institution for homeless poor people funded by the local parish, where the able-bodied were required to work.

working.definition: Form of work (gerund participle present): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workman.definition: A man who labours for wages.

workman’s.definition: A man who labours for wages.

workmen.definition: Form of workman (plural): A man who labours for wages.

workmen’s.definition: Form of workman (plural): A man who labours for wages.

works.definition: Form of work (indicative present singular third-person): To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

workshop.definition: A room, especially one which is not particularly large, used for manufacturing or other light industrial work.

workshops.definition: Form of workshop (plural): A room, especially one which is not particularly large, used for manufacturing or other light industrial work.

workwoman.definition: A woman who performs manual labour.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

world’s.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worshippers.definition: Form of worshipper (plural): A person who worships, especially at a place of assembly for religious services.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

worsted.definition: Yarn made from long strands of wool.

worthing.definition: Form of worth (gerund participle present): To be, become, betide.

worthless.definition: Having no worth or use; without value.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wounded.definition: Form of wound (participle past): To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

wounding.definition: Form of wound (gerund participle present): To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

wounds.definition: Form of wound (plural): An injury, such as a cut, stab, or tear, to a (usually external) part of the body.

wove.definition: Form of weave (past): To form something by passing lengths or strands of material over and under one another.

woven.definition: Form of weave (participle past): To form something by passing lengths or strands of material over and under one another.

wrangling.definition: Form of wrangle (gerund participle present): To convince or influence (someone) by arguing or contending.

wrapper.definition: Something that is wrapped around something else as a cover or protection: a wrapping.

wrecked.definition: Form of wreck (participle past): To destroy violently; to cause severe damage to something, to a point where it no longer works, or is useless.

wrested.definition: Form of wrest (participle past): To pull or twist violently.

wretch.definition: An unhappy, unfortunate, or miserable person.

wretched.definition: Characterized by or feeling deep affliction or distress; very miserable.

wretchedness.definition: An unhappy state of mental or physical suffering.

wretches.definition: Form of wretch (plural): An unhappy, unfortunate, or miserable person.

wringing.definition: Form of wring (gerund participle present): Often followed by out: to squeeze or twist (something moist) tightly so that liquid is forced out.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writers.definition: Form of writer (plural): A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writings.definition: Form of writing (plural): Graphism of symbols such as letters that express some meaning.

written.definition: Form of write (participle past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrongly.definition: In violation of a moral or other standard, code, or convention; in an unfair, unjust, dishonest, or immoral manner; wrongly convicted is synonymous with wrongful conviction and miscarriage of justice.

wrote.definition: Form of write (past): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

y.definition: Form of year (abbreviation): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yards.definition: Form of yard (plural): A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

yearning.definition: Form of yearn (gerund participle present): To have a strong desire for something or to do something; to long for or to do something.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

year’s.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielded.definition: Form of yield (participle past): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yields.definition: Form of yield (indicative present singular third-person): To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoke.definition: Form of yolk (misspelling): The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: Form of youth (plural): The quality or state of being young.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zealous.definition: Full of zeal; ardent, fervent; exhibiting enthusiasm or strong passion, particularly in matters of religion.

zero.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.

zone.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two fr.

zoology.definition: The part of biology relating to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct.
